TRAINING DATA / GITHUB

A task corpus for distilling one model into another.

Run Moonshiner’s bundled coding, tool-use, and instruction-following tasks through a teacher LLM. Use the resulting traces as training data for a student LLM.

Get started ↓Source code ↗
Moonshiner

For people building instruction-following, coding, and tool-use datasets who need more than a collection of final answers.

A PROJECT BY GREG HAVENS

THE PROJECT, IN PRACTICE

What you can do with it.

01

Start with the included tasks

Moonshiner 0.8.23 ships with 3,847 task definitions. Browse the corpus before a run; you do not need to write your own tasks.

02

Keep the development loop

Capture model trajectories, including tool interactions, corrections, and the steps that led to the result.

03

Judge before publishing

Independent review accepts or rejects traces. Rejected work can be retried before it enters the prepared dataset.

04

Keep the queues moving

Seed authoring, tracing, judging, formatting, privacy checks, local storage, and Hugging Face publication run as independent queues.

FROM IDEA TO USE

How it works.

  1. 01

    Choose the teacher

    Select the harness and model that will run the included tasks, a separate judge if using review, and where to keep the results.

  2. 02

    Generate and review

    Run enabled queues and inspect accepted traces, rejections, retries, and throughput.

  3. 03

    Prepare and publish

    Moonshiner formats the traces as structured training data. Hugging Face publishing is optional; training the student is a separate step.

Browse the included task catalog
python3 -m pip install moonshiner
moonshiner seeds catalog

The catalog is read-only and does not call a model. The full pipeline requires teacher access and may incur provider charges.

TAKE IT FOR A SPIN

Start here.

Install the package and browse the included task corpus. Follow the setup guide to choose your teacher and run Moonshiner’s tasks. The resulting traces are inputs for training a different model.

STATUS & REQUIREMENTS

Pi and Codex can author traces and seeds. Claude Code is supported as a judge. Provider access, credentials, and upstream terms depend on your selected configuration.
